title: Free space notifier should offer to empty trashcan when disk full
line: The low disk space notification now has an Empty Trash button when there are files in the trash on that drive.
explanation: The free space notifier's warning only had "Open in Filelight" (or "Open in File Manager") and "Configure Warning…", so emptying the trash, the quickest way to get space back, meant opening a file manager first. The notification now adds an "Empty Trash" action when trashrc says the trash isn't empty and the trash lives on the warned drive (the home trash on the same filesystem, or a .Trash-<uid> / .Trash/<uid> folder at the top of that partition). It runs KIO's DeleteOrTrashJob with the usual confirmation dialog, the same way the Trash applet does, and checks the free space again when it finishes so the warning closes once enough space is back.

commits.message:
freespacenotifier: Offer to empty the trash when the disk is almost full

The low disk space warning only offered to open the drive or configure
it, even when trashed files were taking up space on that drive. It now
also shows an Empty Trash action whenever that trash isn't empty.

BUG: 109259
